name: Sitejabber (SmartCustomer)

sources.title: Homepage — consumer review platform ('Browse millions of reviews'); business CTA now points to smartcustomer.com
SmartCustomer for Business — 'Claim your free profile' via biz.smartcustomer.com/register; Google Review Partner

requirements: A consumer-facing business with customers who can review it — this is a reviews platform, not a product launch board
Free entry point: 'Claim your free profile' at biz.smartcustomer.com/register — claim or create your business page
Paid 'Plans' exist for review-collection tooling, Google Seller Rating syndication, and distribution
Sitejabber has rebranded its business side to SmartCustomer — the Sitejabber consumer review pages still exist and feed it
preparation: Business name, website URL, and contact details
Work email for the biz.smartcustomer.com account
Check whether a Sitejabber page for your domain already exists (they accumulate user-submitted reviews) before creating one
A review-generation plan — the listing is only useful once real customers review you
workflow: Search sitejabber.com for your domain/business name to find an existing page
Register at https://biz.smartcustomer.com/register to claim the free profile
Invite real customers to review; optionally evaluate paid plans for review-collection automation and Google Seller Rating push
watchFor: Rebrand in progress — sitejabber.com consumer side persists, but business tooling moved to smartcustomer.com; don't be confused by two brands
Reviews are user-generated — a claimed page with zero reviews does nothing; and bad reviews are public and persistent
Never solicit fake reviews — the platform's whole value is verified-authentic reviews and it's a Google Review Partner
Paid plans are the monetization — expect sales outreach after claiming
countsAsLive: A public business profile page exists on sitejabber.com (findable via search) and shows claimed/managed status with your business details
unknowns: Free-plan feature limits vs paid plans (pricing page not fetched)
Whether profile pages link dofollow to the business site
Review-volume thresholds needed before a rating displays
